question_text: What founding document said the American colonies were free from Britain?
disambiguation: Easy to mix up with the Constitution. Different jobs: the Declaration of Independence (1776) said we're leaving. The Constitution (1787) said here's how the new country works. One is the goodbye letter; the other is the rulebook.

why_it_matters.text: This was the public, official break — written down for everyone to read. Before it, the colonies were complaining. After it, they were a new country — though the war would last seven more years to make that true on the ground.

fun_fact.text: Did you know the original Declaration went into hiding for 6 years during the war with England moving from location to location in secret?
